vulnerabilities.description: AccessControlBug.withdrawAll() (test_contracts/AccessControlBug.sol#15-20) transfers ether to msg.sender without any access control. Any caller can drain the contract balance in a single transaction.
AccessControlBug.setOwner(address) (test_contracts/AccessControlBug.sol#23-26) lacks an onlyOwner modifier. Anyone can take over ownership of the contract.
AccessControlBug.privileged() (test_contracts/AccessControlBug.sol#30-34) uses tx.origin for authorization, which is vulnerable to phishing attacks through contract intermediaries.
Version constraint ^0.8.20 contains known severe issues (https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/bugs.html)
